description: Plan the grade needed in each upcoming course to reach a target cumulative GPA. Inputs: current_gpa (0 to 7), credits_completed (0 or more), target_gpa (0 to 7), courses (each with an optional name and credits greater than 0) and a scale id, which sets the top grade point the scale allows. It works out the GPA the upcoming credits need, then gives the lowest letter in each course that keeps the plan on track, assuming the other courses meet the same target. Says so when the target is already reached or would take more than one term. Example prompt: "I have a 3.4 GPA over 60 credits. What do I need in each of my four classes next semester to reach 3.5?"

courses.description: The upcoming courses to plan for. Each needs credits greater than 0, and name is optional.

credits.description: Credits for the course, must be greater than 0.

current_gpa.description: Your cumulative GPA so far, between 0 and 7.

scale.description: Grade scale id: "us4", "us4plus", "ontario-college", "uk-classification", "australia-hd" or "weighted-5.0". Defaults to "us4". Ask the student which one their school uses if unsure.

target_gpa.description: The cumulative GPA you want to reach, between 0 and 7.

name: plan_courses

already_there.description: True when the target is already reached, so a 0.0 on the upcoming credits keeps it.

courses.description: One entry per upcoming course, in the order they were passed.

target_letter.description: The lowest letter in the course that keeps the plan on track, when the target can be reached.

target_min_percent.description: The lowest percentage the target letter covers, when the target can be reached.

target_points.description: The grade points the target letter is worth, when the target can be reached.

max_points.description: The top grade point the scale allows.

needed_gpa.description: The GPA needed on the upcoming credits. It is below 0 when the target is already reached, and above the top of the scale when the target takes more than one term.

possible.description: True when the target can be reached with these courses on this scale.

scale.description: The scale id the plan was made on.

scale_name.description: The name of the scale the plan was made on.

upcoming_credits.description: The credits of the courses to plan for.

title: Plan grades for upcoming courses
